name: 92313 · Grand Terrace, CA
findings: ZIP 92313 (Grand Terrace) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92313 (Grand Terrace) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92313 (Grand Terrace) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
